objects.name: Analytic 1767
objects.description: For Android, detect Archive Collected Data from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; File Creation via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: App reads files across multiple directories or databases in background state (collection phase) then invokes archive or compression routines on collected content — read-then-archive sequence is the staging chain]; File Creation via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: App writes archive-like container, high-entropy packaged blob, or .zip/.gz output to app-private or cache path after bulk data collection — archive artifact in private storage is the staging evidence]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: mobile:ForensicArtifacts
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: App reads files across multiple directories or databases in background state (collection phase) then invokes archive or compression routines on collected content — read-then-archive sequence is the staging chain

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: mobile:ForensicArtifacts
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: App writes archive-like container, high-entropy packaged blob, or .zip/.gz output to app-private or cache path after bulk data collection — archive artifact in private storage is the staging evidence

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: mobile:DynamicAnalysis
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Dynamic API/runtime trace: App invokes ZIP, GZIP, or bulk-buffer packaging routines (ZipOutputStream, DeflaterOutputStream, similar) on previously accessed local data in background state

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: mobile:DynamicAnalysis
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Dynamic API/runtime trace: App applies encryption to newly created archive or staged data blob before network transmission — encrypt-after-archive confirms adversary-controlled packing for exfil

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Correlation window between data access, package creation, encryption, and optional network upload
Apps legitimately expected to package local data such as backup, cloud sync, file manager, or media editing apps
Expected storage paths for legitimate archives, exports, or caches
Whether packaging/export behavior should occur only during active user-driven workflows
Number of files or records read in a short interval before archive creation
Minimum output size for suspicious packaged blob or archive
Threshold for identifying encrypted or heavily compressed output
Minimum upload size consistent with recent archive creation
